hooks.prompt: Evaluate whether Claude may finish this turn. The repository requires cross-session continuity. Using $ARGUMENTS, decide whether this turn materially changed a conclusion, design direction, considered alternative, uncertainty, implementation status, blocker, verification result, or next action. If nothing material changed, return {"ok": true}. If material context changed and Claude's response confirms that it updated the appropriate shared document (meta/ongoing-discussions.md for unresolved design work, DESIGN.md for an explicitly accepted durable decision, or HANDOVER.md for implementation state), return {"ok": true}. Otherwise return {"ok": false, "reason": "Update the appropriate shared context document before stopping, without recording a raw transcript or treating an unaccepted recommendation as a decision."}. When stop_hook_active is true and the latest response reports completion of that context update, allow stopping to avoid a loop.
